snippet.title: Help! I've Been Cursed with a Bubble Butt
snippet.description:
Our non-binary protagonist, adrift in their life, is looking at online influencers to fill the void. They wish they could be more like them...and then, POOF—their wish is granted—but with a slight caveat...

Originally a Global Game Jam game from this year's theme, "Bubble" — Help! I've Been Cursed with a Bubble Butt (HIBCWABB) is juicy, polished, and ready for YOU on itch.io and Steam!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3725510/Help_Ive_Been_Cursed_With_a_Bubble_Butt/
itch.io: https://illuminesce.itch.io/bubble-butt

Published by Studio Terranova. Check out our other games here: https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/studioterranova
